name: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image)
description: Google's fastest and cheapest image model, 1K only. Also on WaveSpeedAI. Also on Comfy Cloud. Also on ToAPIs. Adapter written from the provider's docs, not run against the live API yet.

toapis.note: Runs on ToAPIs (a reseller); not run against the live API yet. Crop, mask and references are uploaded to public files.toapis.com URLs. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". The model takes aspect presets: a crop of another shape comes back re-framed and is centre-cropped. Official channel only. ToAPIs has no page of its own for this model yet: it takes Nano Banana 2's official parameters, which is not verified.

gemini.note: Gemini has no mask input: the crop and the mask go along and the prompt tells the model to change the white area only; the stitch keeps the selection.

wavespeed.note: Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". WaveSpeed sends the aspect preset closest to the crop.

comfycloud.note: Runs the Partner Node on Comfy Cloud (paid plan, credits). Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".
